paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within the combined training set utilized for the evaluation of attribution by large language models. The chart contains fifteen distinct slices, representing different data sources, and the total proportion of all slices is approximately 100%. The largest slice, colored blue, represents NQ at 31.3%, followed by SNLI at 15.4% and MULTIFC at 11.3%. Several other slices are colored in shades of orange, including MULTINL at 0.5% and PUBHEALTH at 0.5%, with FEVER accounting for 16.1% and visualized in a vibrant red.  The slice labeled "XSUMHUL" is colored pink and occupies 1.6%, while "VITAMINC" is colored light purple at 13.0%, and "SCIFACT" is colored light green and represents 0.1% of the total.  "ENTFA" is depicted in yellow, accounting for 2.6%, and "FACTCC" and "ANLI" are colored in teal and represent 1.8% and 4.6% respectively. “SQITAIL” is colored coral and represents 1.2%, and “NQ” is colored cyan, representing about 0.5%. The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice and a legend, identifying each data source by color, and the slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest.
